jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager**

About MedGEO

MedGEO is a healthcare technology company transforming how procedural care is documented, understood, and optimized at the point of care. Built by clinicians for clinicians, MedGEO combines intelligent automation, AI, and Smart Vision technology to reduce documentation burden, improve data accuracy, strengthen compliance, and provide healthcare organizations with greater visibility into the clinical, operational, and financial performance of procedural care.

Our technology works directly within operating rooms and procedural environments, helping nurses and clinicians spend less time on administrative tasks and more time focused on patients.

About the Role

MedGEO is seeking a highly motivated **Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager** to lead customer onboarding, clinical implementation, training, go\-live support, adoption, and ongoing customer success for our healthcare technology platform.

This role requires a **nursing background**, with **operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred**. The ideal candidate understands the realities of surgical workflows, clinical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician and nursing workflows, and the operational demands placed on OR teams.

You will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, helping clinical teams successfully adopt MedGEO’s technology and ensuring customers achieve meaningful clinical, operational, and financial value. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role that requires strong communication, project management, technical aptitude, and the ability to work closely with hospital teams as well as MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.

This role requires onsite travel for implementations and go\-lives, with expected travel ranging from approximately **20% to 50% of the time**, depending on customer growth, implementation schedules, go\-live activity, and business needs.

Because MedGEO is still in an early and formative stage of growth, this role also includes the opportunity to participate in the company’s long\-term upside through **early equity in the company**. We are looking for someone who wants to help build the customer success and implementation function, contribute meaningfully to the company’s growth, and share in the value they help create as MedGEO scales.

The right person will be comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment, rolling up their sleeves during implementations and go\-lives, and helping build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Implementation \& Go\-Live Support

* Lead end\-to\-end clinical implementation processes, including planning, workflow assessment, training, go\-live readiness, launch support, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Work directly with OR nurses, surgeons, perioperative leaders, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, and other customer stakeholders.
* Assess current clinical workflows and determine how MedGEO should be incorporated into existing surgical and procedural processes.
* Support implementation of MedGEO workflows related to surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, intraoperative resource utilization, Smart Vision, and related platform capabilities.
* Develop implementation plans, timelines, milestones, training schedules, and go\-live readiness criteria.
* Provide onsite and remote support during customer onboarding, training, go\-live, and optimization periods.
* Proactively identify implementation risks, workflow issues, adoption barriers, and customer concerns, and escalate as needed.

Customer Success \& Adoption

* Serve as a trusted clinical and operational partner for assigned customers.
* Build strong relationships with frontline clinicians, nurse managers, perioperative directors, surgeons, IT teams, supply chain, revenue cycle, and executive stakeholders.
* Monitor customer adoption, utilization, engagement, satisfaction, and workflow performance.
* Identify adoption gaps and work directly with customer teams to improve usage, training, and workflow alignment.
* Provide ongoing education and support to existing and new users.
* Communicate new MedGEO functionality, best practices, and workflow recommendations to customers.
* Help develop customer champions who can support adoption internally and serve as references for MedGEO externally.

Product Commercialization \& Voice of the Customer

* Serve as a bridge between customers and MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.
* Translate frontline clinical feedback into clear product recommendations, workflow improvements, training needs, and commercialization priorities.
* Help Product and Engineering understand how MedGEO performs in real\-world OR and procedural environments.
* Identify recurring customer pain points, workflow challenges, usability issues, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Support rollout of new product capabilities, modules, Smart Vision enhancements, analytics features, and workflow tools.
* Contribute to customer\-facing materials, training resources, workflow guides, implementation playbooks, and product adoption best practices.
* Help determine whether new product features are ready for broader customer rollout based on usability, workflow fit, customer readiness, and measurable value.

Customer Value, Expansion \& Retention

* Help customers understand and measure the clinical, operational, and financial value generated by MedGEO.
* Track improvements in documentation efficiency, utilization capture, accuracy, compliance, workflow performance, and financial outcomes.
* Support customer business reviews, ROI discussions, executive updates, and account health reporting.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to identify opportunities for renewals, upsells, expansions, and additional deployments across ORs, service lines, departments, facilities, and health\-system locations.
* Support customer retention by ensuring strong adoption, responsiveness, and demonstrated value.
* Contribute to case studies, testimonials, success stories, and reference materials.

Internal Coordination \& Tools

* Use tools such as **Jira, Slack, CRM systems, project trackers, shared documentation platforms, and other workflow tools** to manage tasks, customer updates, implementation progress, product feedback, and internal communication.
* Document customer issues, workflow needs, implementation milestones, product requests, and follow\-up items clearly and consistently.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering through Jira or similar tools to report bugs, prioritize customer\-impacting issues, and track resolution.
* Communicate effectively with internal teams through Slack, email, meetings, and project management tools.
* Maintain accurate customer records, implementation notes, account updates, risks, and action items.

Required Qualifications

* **Registered Nurse or clinical nursing background required.**
* **Operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred.**
* Strong understanding of OR workflows, surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician workflows, nursing workflows, and multidisciplinary surgical teams.
* Experience working with surgeons, OR nurses, perioperative leadership, anesthesia teams, surgical technologists, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, or revenue cycle teams.
* Experience in clinical implementation, customer success, healthcare technology, clinical education, nursing leadership, informatics, medical device, or healthcare operations.
* Strong technical aptitude and comfort learning healthcare software platforms.
* Ability to train clinical users and explain technology in a clear, practical, workflow\-focused way.
* Familiarity with tools such as **Jira, Slack, CRM systems, project management tools, and shared documentation platforms**.
* Strong project management, organizational, and follow\-through skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and internal stakeholders at the same time.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both frontline clinicians and executive hospital leadership.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can evolve quickly.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately **20% to 50%** for implementations, training, go\-lives, workflow assessments, and customer optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

* CNOR certification or prior circulating OR nurse experience.
* Experience as an OR nurse manager, clinical educator, perioperative coordinator, surgical services leader, or clinical informatics specialist.
* Experience implementing healthcare technology, EHR systems, perioperative systems, medical device software, or digital workflow solutions.
* Familiarity with Epic OpTime, HST, SIS, Cerner, or other perioperative or procedural systems.
* Experience with implant\-heavy specialties such as orthopedics, spine, cardiovascular, plastics, oral surgery, or other procedural service lines.
* Experience working with hospital IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, clinical operations, or clinical informatics teams.
* Previous experience in customer success, clinical implementation, clinical solutions, or healthcare SaaS is highly valuable.

Who Will Thrive at MedGEO

The right person for this role understands the operating room because they have worked in or around one. You can walk into a procedural environment, understand what the clinical team is doing, identify where documentation or workflow gaps occur, and translate those observations into practical recommendations for customers and internal teams.

You are clinically credible, technically curious, highly organized, and comfortable communicating with everyone from frontline nurses to surgeons, administrators, engineers, and executives. You are willing to roll up your sleeves during go\-lives, solve problems in real time, and help build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to combine nursing experience, healthcare technology, customer leadership, implementation, and product commercialization in a high\-impact role at an early\-stage company.

jobs.description:
**About Uplinq**

  

Uplinq is the AI\-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re\-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real\-time clarity and control.

  

We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution\-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

 **Individual applicants residing in the US only**  

  

**About the role**


As a Senior Onboarding Accounting Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for new Uplinq clients — guiding them through system setup, data clean\-up, and account activation.


This is a high\-touch, high\-volume role: you'll juggle a large, active portfolio of clients at different onboarding stages, which means the job rewards people who communicate early and often, adapt quickly when something isn't working, and hold themselves accountable for outcomes rather than just effort.


The right candidate will have a magnetic presence on calls and an excitement about interaction with small business owners. The ideal candidate is a person the clients look forward to speaking with, someone who makes them feel confident in the investment they’ve made when choosing Uplinq.

 **What you'll do**

* Lead daily client meetings to gather financial data, clarify scope, and build trust from the first call — earning it through rapport, clarity, and follow\-through, not just technical accuracy.
* Set up and configure Uplinq and QuickBooks Online accounts, including resolving integration and access issues (Plaid connections, payroll, revenue processors, inventory systems, etc) so systems sync cleanly from day one.
* Compare signed proposals to actual client needs in the first call, and flag scope or pricing mismatches immediately — to sales, to your manager, and directly to the client — rather than letting a gap surface later and erode trust.
* Manage a high volume of onboarding timelines and deliverables simultaneously, and proactively speak up when your workload or a specific account is at risk of falling behind, so it can be addressed before it becomes a bigger problem.
* Troubleshoot setup and data issues using sound accounting judgment, and treat mistakes as fast information rather than something to hide — surface them quickly, learn from them, and adjust.
* Find workarounds to keep stalled onboardings moving — manual data entry when a feed breaks, alternate document paths, creative scheduling — because an on\-time, good\-enough solution beats a stalled account waiting for a perfect one.
* Collaborate with Sales, Initialization, Accounting, and Tax teams to resolve handoff gaps, own your part of the process end\-to\-end, and transition accounts smoothly into ongoing support.

 **Qualifications**

* 6\+ years in a client\-facing accounting or onboarding role, ideally in public or multi\-client accounting firm as Senior Associate level or higher
* 6\+ years of daily QuickBooks use including Online setup, integrations, and troubleshooting (not desktop).
* Strong working knowledge of both cash\- and accrual\-based accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 25\+ active client relationships at once without letting communication or follow\-through slip — someone who escalates early, adapts on the fly, and takes ownership of outcomes rather than absorbing pressure silently.
* A warm, confident, and memorable presence with clients — someone who builds real rapport fast, puts anxious business owners at ease, and makes a technical process feel personal rather than transactional.
* Comfortable having direct conversations with clients about scope and pricing when what they signed doesn't match what they need, and willing to admit and correct course quickly when something's off.

 **Why Join Us**

* Competitive pay \+ health, dental, vision, 401(k), and life insurance
* Remote\-first and flexible work culture
* Clear path for career growth in a fast\-growing firm
* Modern tech stack and automation\-first mindset
* Supportive, collaborative team with strong systems and documentation

**Senior Training Specialist**
==============================


**Location:** Carlisle, PA  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM  

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – up to 2 days per week remote  

**Travel:** 10–15%


**About the Role**
------------------



Are you passionate about creating learning experiences that make a real impact? We are looking for a **Senior Training Specialist** to join our team and help shape how employees learn, grow, and succeed across the organization.



In this senior\-level role, you will lead the **design, development, delivery, and continuous improvement of enterprise\-wide learning programs**, with a primary focus on building and owning a consistent, engaging onboarding experience for new employees across divisions and functions.



You will partner with leaders, subject matter experts, trainers, HR, and other stakeholders to understand business needs and develop learning solutions that support employee performance and organizational goals. This role offers the opportunity to influence learning strategy while remaining hands\-on in program development and delivery.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Enterprise Learning \& Onboarding**


* Lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing management of an **enterprise\-wide onboarding program** that creates a consistent and engaging experience for new hires across all divisions and functions.
* Partner with hiring managers and HR teams to develop onboarding resources, and coordinate learning activities.
* Analyze organizational and training needs to develop new programs or enhance existing learning solutions.
* Arrange and promote technical, professional, leadership, and other development opportunities across the organization.

### **Training Design \& Delivery**


* Design and develop training programs using a variety of delivery methods, including classroom training, e\-learning, virtual workshops, and on\-the\-job training.
* Lead classroom, virtual, and on\-the\-job training sessions, including coordinating schedules, logistics, materials, and participants.
* Develop engaging learning materials, including presentations, facilitator guides, participant guides, outlines, handouts, and other resources.
* Utilize e\-learning development tools, including **Articulate**, to create effective digital learning experiences.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts, trainers, and business stakeholders to ensure learning content is accurate, relevant, and aligned with business needs.
* Evaluate training materials and programs developed by other instructors and provide feedback to improve effectiveness.
* Conduct workshop observations for new instructors and provide coaching and feedback to support effective training delivery.

### **Business Partnership \& Consulting**


* Build strong relationships with leaders, hiring managers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to understand business needs and recommend appropriate learning solutions.
* Coach stakeholders to identify the right solution for their learning and development needs rather than defaulting to training as the answer.
* Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through data, feedback, and learner insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support organizational change initiatives through effective communication, learning solutions, and stakeholder partnership.

### **Vendor \& Program Management**


* Manage relationships with external training vendors, including **sourcing, contracting, coordinating, and evaluating vendor performance and quality**.

jobs.description:
Description: **About PreBorn!**


PreBorn! is a national nonprofit ministry dedicated to providing life\-affirming care through clinics, telehealth, and strategic partnerships. With a growing team and expanding reach, we are committed to excellence in storytelling, donor engagement, and mission\-driven communications that save lives and souls.

**Position Summary**


The?**EMR Implementation Specialist** is responsible for supporting the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization of PreBorn!’s Electronic Medical Record (EMR) platform across affiliated pregnancy clinics.


Reporting to the?**Vice President of Virtual Care Services (VP VCS)**, this role serves as a primary bridge between PreBorn!, participating clinics, technology teams, and EMR vendors. The EMR Implementation Specialist guides clinics through implementation from initial readiness and workflow discovery through configuration, data preparation, testing, training coordination, go\-live, and post\-implementation stabilization.


This is a highly hands\-on role requiring strong project coordination, technical aptitude, clinic relationship management, and the ability to translate operational and clinical workflows into effective system processes. The successful candidate will understand that implementation success is measured not simply by deploying software, but by helping clinics confidently adopt technology that strengthens operational excellence and supports their life\-saving ministry.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Clinic EMR Implementation**
* **Workflow Discovery \& System Configuration**
* **Data Migration \& System Readiness**
* **Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* **Training \& Clinic Adoption**
* **Go\-Live \& Post\-Implementation Support**
* **Clinic Relationship Management**
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


Partner closely with:

* Vice President of Virtual Care Services
* VCS clinical and operational leadership
* Software development and technology teams
* EMR product/project leadership
* Training and education resources
* Clinic Engagement and Client Services teams
* Compliance and security resources
* External EMR vendors and technical partners, as applicable


Serve as the voice of clinic implementation by communicating recurring workflow challenges, user feedback, system gaps, and opportunities for product improvement.

**Ministry \& Culture Expectations**


As a member of the PreBorn! team, the EMR Implementation Specialist is expected to demonstrate an unwavering commitment to Jesus Christ, the sanctity of human life, and the mission of PreBorn!.


The individual must:

* Profess Jesus Christ as Savior and Lord.
* Agree with and support PreBorn!’s Statement of Faith.
* Maintain a 100% pro\-life position.
* Participate in the prayer\-centered culture of the ministry.
* Demonstrate PreBorn!’s core values of?**Steadfast, Adaptable, Integrity, Fruitful, and Prayerful**.
* Approach clinic partners with humility, service, professionalism, and a commitment to excellence.
* Recognize technology as a tool to strengthen clinics in their mission to save lives and souls

**Physical \& Travel Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods using computers and virtual communication systems.
* Ability to travel periodically to participating clinics throughout the United States.
* Travel may increase during periods of active clinic implementation and go\-live.
* Ability to provide onsite implementation support for multiple consecutive days when necessary.


Requirements: **Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, information systems, business, project management, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 3\+ years of experience supporting software, EMR/EHR, healthcare technology, SaaS implementation, or similar system implementations.
* Experience working directly with end users during technology implementation or adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementation projects and competing priorities.
* Strong understanding of workflow analysis, process documentation, and change management.
* Ability to learn complex software systems quickly and translate technical concepts for nontechnical users.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively across clinical, operational, and technical teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel to clinics as needed during implementation and go\-live.

**Preferred**

* Direct experience implementing an?**EMR or EHR system**.
* Experience working in outpatient healthcare, women's health, pregnancy clinics, telehealth, or similar clinical environments.
* Experience with healthcare data migration and system configuration.
* Familiarity with HIPAA, healthcare privacy, role\-based access, and clinical data security principles.
* Experience conducting user acceptance testing and supporting software go\-lives.
* Experience developing implementation documentation, workflows, and training resources.
* Familiarity with project management tools and implementation methodologies.
* Experience supporting multi\-site or geographically dispersed healthcare organizations.

**Core Competencies**

* **Implementation Ownership:**?Drives assigned clinic implementations from kickoff through successful adoption.
* **Technical Aptitude:**?Quickly understands system functionality, integrations, workflows, and technical dependencies.
* **Project Management:** Maintains timelines, milestones, responsibilities, risks, and deliverables.
* **Problem Solving:** Identifies root causes and drives practical solutions.
* **Clinic Partnership:**?Builds credibility and trusted relationships with clinic leaders and staff.
* **Change Management:**?Helps users navigate operational and technology changes successfully.
* **Communication:**?Translates effectively between technical teams, clinical users, and organizational leadership.
* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains accurate configuration, documentation, testing, and implementation records.
* **Adaptability:**?Effectively supports clinics with different workflows, resources, and levels of technical maturity.
